offering_description.value: Provides broadband, mobile, voice and television services to households and businesses, primarily in rural U.S. and island markets. It operates fiber and wireless networks and also provides managed connectivity and wholesale network services to businesses, government agencies and other carriers.

primary_services.value: fixed broadband; mobile wireless; wholesale carrier connectivity; managed business networking; fixed voice and pay television

customer_segment.value: B2C: households and individual mobile subscribers; B2B: local businesses, enterprise network customers and telecommunications carriers; B2G: government agencies and public institutions buying connectivity

end_markets.value: residential internet and mobile communications; enterprise networking; wholesale telecommunications; public-sector connectivity

revenue_model.value: subscription: recurring broadband, mobile, voice, television and managed network plans; project or contract: wholesale network access, transport and enterprise connectivity agreements; transaction or usage fees: pay-as-you-go mobile service; product sales: mobile phones and accessories
revenue_model.category: subscription; project or contract; transaction or usage fees; product sales

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: deploys fiber and wireless infrastructure to connect households, businesses and other carriers; service provider: uses its network capacity to deliver retail communications, managed networking and wholesale transport

geography_served.value: global: Alaska, rural western U.S., U.S. Virgin Islands, Bermuda, Cayman Islands and Guyana

specialization.value: related lines: fixed broadband, mobile wireless, voice, pay television, managed networking and wholesale carrier services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: account teams for enterprise, government and wholesale carrier customers; own locations: operator-branded stores and service centers; online: local operator websites for consumer plans and service orders

regulatory_exposure.value: high: telecom operating authorizations and wireless spectrum licenses overseen by the FCC and local communications regulators

notes: The current footprint of smaller operations and the availability of online ordering may vary by market.
